senses.definition: Any of a group of inherited connective tissue disorders caused by a defect in the synthesis of collagen, and resulting in abnormally elastic skin, joints, muscles, etc.
senses.example: But [Lena] Dunham also writes, in a wry and rueful voice, about her struggles with painful chronic illness (Dunham has endometriosis and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome); […].

senses.definition: A theorem showing that if, in a given universe, all freely falling observers measure the cosmic background radiation to have exactly the same properties in all directions (isotropic), then that universe is an isotropic and homogeneous FLRW spacetime.
Any of a group of equations that describe changes in specific heat capacity and derivatives of specific volume in second-order phase transitions.
A model of diffusion used to explain the second law of thermodynamics, considering a number of particles in two containers, which independently change container at a certain rate.

A relativistic paradox concerning the concept of Born rigidity within special relativity, where an ideally rigid cylinder that is made to rotate about its axis of symmetry. The radius R as seen in the laboratory frame is always perpendicular to its motion and should therefore be equal to its value R₀ when stationary. H

A theorem that relates the time derivative of the expectation values of the position and momentum operators x and p to the expectation value of the force F=-V'(x) on a massive particle moving in a scalar potential V(x).
An optical illusion in which the sides of a square placed inside a pattern of concentric circles take an apparent curved shape.
A reagent made from paradimethylaminobenzaldehyde, ethanol and concentrated hydrochloric acid, primarily used to identify indoles.
